protocol.labels: manual lap events, uncertain tap delay and front-of-door position; no independent surveyed door distance
protocol.units: microtesla, seconds, redetected steps, room intervals; no metre accuracy claim
protocol.clock: monotonic sensor clock with file-level p05 wall offset; callback-clock sensitivity also saved
protocol.training: same platform; held-out session and held-out date; same and both travel directions
protocol.segmentTest: optimistic boundary-known classification of nine adjacent-room pairs, not live room recognition
protocol.arrivalTest: known first room only; subsequent target labels only score output; two consecutive observations confirm crossing; no yaw, AP, BLE or production correction
